name: FirstUK Bank — Information Security Policy
description: The formal governing instrument for information security at FirstUK Bank, version 2.0, effective from 2026-01-15. It is owned by the Chief Information Security Officer and managed by the Technology department.

name: FCA Conduct of Business Sourcebook Part 5
description: A regulatory reference from the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) that informs the requirements of the Information Security Policy.

name: PRA Operational Resilience
description: Regulatory guidance from the Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA) regarding operational resilience that the Information Security Policy must comply with.

name: Chief Information Security Officer
description: The abstract role designated as the owner of the Information Security Policy, responsible for its governance and maintenance.

name: All Staff
description: The collective group of all bank employees who are within the target audience and subject to the mandates of the Information Security Policy.
context: Audience | All Staff, Technology, Risk, Board

name: Technology
description: The technology-focused staff collective identified as a primary audience for the Information Security Policy.
context: Audience | All Staff, Technology, Risk, Board

name: Risk
description: The risk-focused staff collective identified as a primary audience for the Information Security Policy.
context: Audience | All Staff, Technology, Risk, Board

name: Board
description: The bank's governing board identified as a primary audience for the Information Security Policy.
context: Audience | All Staff, Technology, Risk, Board

name: Information Security Policy
description: A formal governing instrument designed to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of FirstUK Bank's customer data, systems, and intellectual property.
context: FirstUK Bank maintains an Information Security Policy to protect confidentiality, integrity, and availability of customer data, systems, and intellectual property

name: Cyberattacks
description: Threats involving malicious digital attacks against the bank's systems and data.
context: protect confidentiality, integrity, and availability of customer data, systems, and intellectual property against threats (cyberattacks, unauthorized access, data breaches)

name: Unauthorized Access
description: The risk of individuals gaining access to systems or data without proper authorization.
context: protect confidentiality, integrity, and availability of customer data, systems, and intellectual property against threats (cyberattacks, unauthorized access, data breaches)

name: Data Breaches
description: The risk of unauthorized disclosure or loss of sensitive customer data and intellectual property.
context: protect confidentiality, integrity, and availability of customer data, systems, and intellectual property against threats (cyberattacks, unauthorized access, data breaches)

name: Information Security Policy
description: A formal policy establishing security procedures to prevent unauthorized access, protect customer data, ensure system reliability, and maintain regulatory compliance.

name: Prevention of Unauthorized Access to Systems and Data
description: A requirement to implement security procedures specifically designed to prevent unauthorized access to the bank's systems and data.

name: Protection of Customer Data Against Breaches
description: A mandate to establish procedures that protect customer data from security breaches.

name: Ensuring System Availability and Reliability
description: A requirement to maintain security procedures that guarantee the availability and reliability of bank systems.

name: Rapid Response to Security Incidents
description: An obligation to ensure the bank can respond rapidly to security incidents through established procedures.

name: Compliance with Regulatory Security Standards
description: A requirement to ensure that security procedures meet the standards set by the PRA and FCA.
context: Meet regulatory security standards (PRA Operational Resilience, FCA)

name: Prudential Regulation Authority Operational Resilience
description: Regulatory standards issued by the PRA regarding operational resilience that the bank's security procedures must meet.
context: Meet regulatory security standards (PRA Operational Resilience, FCA)

name: Financial Conduct Authority
description: The regulatory body whose security standards must be met by the bank's security procedures.
context: Meet regulatory security standards (PRA Operational Resilience, FCA)

name: Unauthorized Access
description: The risk of unauthorized individuals gaining access to the bank's systems or data.

name: Data Breach
description: The risk of customer data being compromised or breached.

name: System Unavailability
description: The risk that systems may become unavailable or unreliable, impacting bank operations.

name: Security Incident
description: General security incidents that require a rapid response to mitigate impact.

name: Information Security Policy
description: A governing policy document defining the scope of security protections for the bank's data, systems, and personnel. It establishes the boundaries for all physical and digital assets across all geographic locations.
context: Applies to: All customer data (personal, financial)

name: All Staff
description: The collective group of all bank employees who fall within the scope of the policy's security requirements.
context: Applies to: All staff, contractors, third parties

name: Contractors
description: External personnel providing services to the bank who are subject to the policy's security and data handling mandates.
context: Applies to: All staff, contractors, third parties

name: Third Parties
description: External entities or organizations that fall under the scope of the bank's security policy.
context: Applies to: All staff, contractors, third parties

name: Customer Data Protection
description: The operational requirement to apply security controls to all personal and financial customer data.
context: Applies to: All customer data (personal, financial)

name: Systems and Infrastructure Security
description: The application of security measures across all of the bank's technical systems and underlying infrastructure.
context: Applies to: All systems and infrastructure

name: FirstUK Bank Information Security Policy
description: The governing policy document establishing FirstUK Bank's commitment to protecting customer data and systems. It mandates a strategy based on defense-in-depth security controls, incident response, and continuous threat monitoring.
context: FirstUK Bank protects customer data and systems through defense-in-depth security controls, incident response, and continuous threat monitoring.

name: Requirement for Defense-in-Depth Security Controls
description: A mandatory requirement for the bank to implement a layered security approach (defense-in-depth) to protect customer data and systems.
context: FirstUK Bank protects customer data and systems through defense-in-depth security controls

name: Requirement for Incident Response
description: A mandatory requirement for the bank to maintain and execute incident response procedures to protect customer data and systems.
context: FirstUK Bank protects customer data and systems through... incident response

name: Requirement for Continuous Threat Monitoring
description: A mandatory requirement for the bank to perform ongoing monitoring of threats to ensure the protection of customer data and systems.
context: FirstUK Bank protects customer data and systems through... continuous threat monitoring.

name: Defense-in-Depth Security Controls
description: The operational implementation of layered security safeguards used to protect the bank's systems and customer data.
context: FirstUK Bank protects customer data and systems through defense-in-depth security controls

name: Incident Response Mechanism
description: The operational process and tools used to respond to security incidents to mitigate impact on customer data and systems.
context: FirstUK Bank protects customer data and systems through... incident response

name: Continuous Threat Monitoring
description: The technical mechanism used for the ongoing detection and monitoring of threats against the bank's infrastructure and data.
context: FirstUK Bank protects customer data and systems through... continuous threat monitoring.

name: Information Security Risk
description: The risk of unauthorized access, loss, or compromise of customer data and bank systems which the policy aims to mitigate.
context: FirstUK Bank protects customer data and systems

name: Security Principles
description: A governing set of security principles defining FirstUK Bank's stance on system and data protection. It establishes the foundational frameworks of Zero-Trust, Defense-in-Depth, and the CIA Triad.

name: Zero-Trust Security Principle
description: A policy-level principle stating that no implicit trust is granted to users, devices, or networks. It mandates continuous authentication and the proactive assumption of breach.

name: Defense-in-Depth Principle
description: A policy-level principle requiring multiple layers of security controls to ensure there is no single point of failure. Protections must be layered across networks, systems, data, and processes.

name: Confidentiality-Integrity-Availability (CIA Triad) Principle
description: A policy-level principle ensuring data is encrypted and access-controlled (Confidentiality), cannot be modified without authorization (Integrity), and systems remain accessible when needed (Availability).
context: Integrity: Data cannot be modified without authorization

name: Mandatory Verification of Every Access Request
description: A requirement under the Zero-Trust framework that every single access request must be verified without exception.

name: Requirement for Continuous Authentication and Authorization
description: A mandate requiring that authentication and authorization processes occur continuously rather than as a one-time event.

name: Prohibition of Single Points of Failure in Security
description: A requirement that security architecture must be designed such that no single point of failure exists, necessitating multiple layers of control.

name: Data Encryption
description: An operational safeguard used to ensure the confidentiality of data as part of the CIA Triad.

name: Access Control
description: A mechanism used to restrict data access to authorized users to maintain confidentiality and integrity.
context: Data cannot be modified without authorization

name: Unauthorized Access
description: The risk of users, devices, or networks gaining access to systems or data without proper authorization, addressed by Zero-Trust and CIA principles.
context: Data cannot be modified without authorization

name: System Breach
description: The risk of a security compromise, which the policy mandates the bank must assume has already occurred to defend proactively.

name: Cyberattacks
description: A category of threats monitored by FirstUK Bank encompassing malicious digital attacks. This includes ransomware, malware, and phishing attempts.

name: Unauthorized Access
description: The risk of unauthorized entry into bank systems or data. This is characterized by hacking, credential theft, and social engineering.
context: Unauthorized Access: Hacking, credential theft, social engineering

name: Data Breaches
description: The risk involving the theft or exposure of sensitive bank or customer data.
context: Data Breaches: Sensitive data theft, exposure

name: Insider Threats
description: Risks originating from within the organization, specifically from disgruntled staff or inadvertent disclosure of information.
context: Insider Threats: Disgruntled staff, inadvertent disclosure

name: Third-Party Risk
description: Risks associated with external partners, specifically vendor compromise and supply chain attacks.
context: Third-Party Risk: Vendor compromise, supply chain attacks

name: Natural Disasters
description: Environmental risks that may impact bank operations, including power outages, fire, and flooding.
context: Natural Disasters: Power outages, fire, flooding

name: Access Control Policy
description: A formal policy governing the authentication requirements for both customers and staff to ensure secure access to bank systems and facilities.

name: Customer Online Banking Authentication Requirement
description: Mandates that customers accessing Online Banking must be authenticated using a combination of username, password, and a One-Time Password (OTP) delivered via email or SMS.

name: Customer Mobile App Authentication Requirement
description: Requires customers using the Mobile App to authenticate via biometrics (fingerprint or face), with an optional PIN requirement.

name: Customer Branch Authentication Requirement
description: Mandates the use of photo ID verification for customers authenticating in person at a bank branch.

name: Staff General Authentication Requirement
description: Requires staff to authenticate using LDAP/Active Directory credentials consisting of a username and password.

name: Privileged Access MFA Requirement
description: Mandates Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for staff with privileged access, specifically those in admin and compliance roles.

name: Physical Facility Access Requirement
description: Requires the use of physical badges to gain access to bank facilities.

name: Remote Access VPN Requirement
description: Mandates the use of a Virtual Private Network (VPN) for all staff accessing bank systems remotely.

name: Multi-Factor Authentication
description: Technical control requiring multiple forms of verification, implemented as OTP for online banking and MFA for privileged staff access.

name: Biometric Authentication
description: Technical control using physical characteristics (fingerprint/face) to authenticate customers on the mobile application.

name: LDAP/Active Directory
description: Centralized directory service used for managing and authenticating staff credentials.

name: Virtual Private Network
description: Secure encrypted tunnel required for staff to establish remote connections to the bank's internal network.

name: Customer
description: Individuals accessing bank services via online, mobile, or branch channels who must undergo specific authentication processes.

name: Staff
description: Bank employees required to authenticate via LDAP/AD and use physical badges for facility access.

name: Privileged Access Users
description: Staff members in administrative or compliance roles who are subject to stricter MFA authentication requirements.

name: Authorization Policy
description: A policy governing access control, segregation of duties, and logging requirements to ensure data security and operational integrity within FirstUK Bank.

name: Implementation of Role-Based Access Control
description: Mandates that system and data access be restricted based on the specific role of the staff member, ensuring users only access data necessary for their function.
context: Customer-facing staff: Limited customer data (own customers)
Compliance staff: Full data access + audit logging

name: Segregation of Duties Requirements
description: Prohibits the same individual from performing conflicting functions, specifically separating initiation from approval and administration from development.

name: Access Logging and Monitoring Mandate
description: Requires that all system access be logged with specific metadata and that suspicious patterns be flagged for review.
context: All access logged (who, what, when, where)

name: Audit Log Retention Period
description: Specifies that audit logs must be retained for a minimum period of one year.

name: Quarterly Access Review Schedule
description: Mandates that access reviews be conducted on a periodic, quarterly basis.

name: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
description: A technical control mechanism used to restrict system access to authorized users based on their organizational role.

name: Audit Logging
description: A monitoring mechanism that records the identity of the user, the action taken, the timestamp, and the location of access.
context: Compliance staff: Full data access + audit logging
Technology staff: System access with audit trail
All access logged (who, what, when, where)

name: Customer-facing staff
description: Staff members who interact with customers and are restricted to accessing only the data of their own assigned customers.
context: Customer-facing staff: Limited customer data (own customers)

name: Compliance staff
description: Staff responsible for compliance who are granted full data access subject to audit logging.
context: Compliance staff: Full data access + audit logging

name: Technology staff
description: Staff responsible for technical systems who have system access governed by an audit trail.
context: Technology staff: System access with audit trail

name: Executives
description: Senior leadership restricted to viewing aggregated reports rather than granular data.

name: Developers
description: Staff responsible for software development, restricted to accessing pre-production environments only.

name: Data Encryption Policy
description: A formal policy governing the encryption of data both in transit and for remote access to ensure the security of bank communications.

name: Mandatory Encryption of Internet-Facing Connections
description: Requirement that all connections facing the internet must be encrypted using TLS 1.3.

name: Enforcement of HTTPS and HTTP Redirection
description: Requirement to enforce HTTPS for web traffic and ensure all HTTP requests are redirected to HTTPS.

name: Mandatory mTLS for Internal Service Communication
description: Requirement for mutual TLS (mTLS) to be used for all communication between internal services.

name: Certificate Management Obligations
description: Obligation to maintain certificates through automated renewal and continuous monitoring.

name: Mandatory VPN Usage for Remote Staff
description: Requirement that all staff working remotely must utilize a VPN for network access.

name: Encryption of Remote Access Traffic
description: Requirement that all traffic for remote access must be encrypted via a secure tunnel.
context: All traffic encrypted through secure tunnel

name: Multi-factor Authentication for VPN Access
description: Requirement for multi-factor authentication to be implemented for VPN access.

name: Transport Layer Security 1.3
description: The technical standard used to encrypt internet-facing connections.

name: Mutual TLS
description: A security mechanism used for verifying the identity of both parties in internal service-to-service communication.

name: Virtual Private Network
description: A secure tunnel mechanism used to encrypt traffic for staff accessing the network remotely.

name: Multi-factor Authentication
description: An authentication safeguard required for accessing the bank's network via VPN.

name: Remote Staff
description: Bank employees working from remote locations who are obligated to use VPNs and MFA.

name: Information Security Policy - Data at Rest
description: A policy governing the encryption and secure handling of data at rest, covering databases, backups, and file storage to ensure sensitive information is protected from unauthorized access.

name: Mandatory AES-256 Encryption for Sensitive Database Columns
description: Requires that sensitive columns within databases be encrypted using the AES-256 standard.

name: Separation of Encryption Keys from Data
description: Mandates that encryption keys must be stored separately from the encrypted data, specifically utilizing a Hardware Security Module (HSM).

name: Mandatory Encryption for Backups to S3
description: Requires all backups sent to S3 to be encrypted using the AES-256 encryption standard.

name: Secure Deletion of Files via DoD Standard
description: Requires that the deletion of files be performed via secure overwriting in accordance with the DoD standard.

name: Department of Defense (DoD) Data Sanitization Standard
description: An external standard used to define the requirements for secure overwriting and deletion of data.

name: Unauthorized Data Access
description: The risk of sensitive data being accessed by unauthorized parties, mitigated through encryption of databases, backups, and portable devices.

name: AES-256 Encryption
description: The technical implementation of the Advanced Encryption Standard with a 256-bit key used for databases and backups.

name: Hardware Security Module (HSM)
description: A physical device used to securely store and manage encryption keys separately from the data.

name: AWS Key Management Service (KMS)
description: A cloud-based service used for the management of encryption keys for S3 backups.

name: Transparent Application-Level Encryption
description: Encryption implemented at the application layer to ensure data is encrypted transparently.

name: Secure Overwriting
description: The process of overwriting data to ensure it cannot be recovered after deletion, following the DoD standard.

name: Network Security Policy
description: A formal policy governing the security of the bank's network infrastructure, specifically focusing on perimeter security, firewall configurations, and threat mitigation.

name: Stateful Inspection Firewall Requirement
description: Mandates the use of a stateful inspection firewall to manage network traffic flow.

name: Public API Ingress Restriction
description: Restricts incoming network traffic for public APIs to Port 443 (HTTPS) only.
context: Ingress: Port 443 (HTTPS) only for public APIs

name: Whitelist-Based Egress Control
description: Requires that outbound network traffic be restricted based on a predefined whitelist.

name: Firewall Rule Logging and Monitoring
description: Requires that all firewall rules are logged and continuously monitored for security purposes.

name: DDoS Protection Implementation
description: Mandates the implementation of managed DDoS protection and traffic management to prevent service disruption.

name: Intrusion Detection and Prevention Requirement
description: Requires the deployment of both network-based and host-based intrusion detection systems with automated response capabilities.

name: Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS)
description: The risk of service unavailability caused by anomalous traffic volumes or targeted DDoS attacks.

name: Network Intrusion
description: The risk of malicious actors gaining unauthorized access to the network or critical systems.

name: Stateful Inspection Firewall
description: A technical control used to monitor the state of active connections to determine which network packets to allow through.

name: AWS Shield
description: A managed DDoS protection service used to safeguard the bank's network perimeter.

name: API Rate Limiting
description: A mechanism to limit the number of requests to APIs to prevent abuse and DDoS attacks.

name: Network-based IDS
description: A system that monitors network traffic for malicious activity using Snort-like rules.

name: Host-based IDS
description: A security system installed on critical servers to detect internal intrusions or unauthorized changes.

name: Automated IP Blocking
description: An automated response mechanism that blocks malicious IP addresses upon detection of an intrusion.

name: Internal Network Segmentation Policy
description: A formal policy governing the technical separation of network environments to protect sensitive data and restrict unauthorized access across different system tiers.

name: Mandatory Network Segregation of System Tiers
description: Requires the bank to maintain separate subnets for customer-facing systems and internal staff systems, while ensuring the database tier is isolated with restricted access and development systems are separated from production.

name: Mandatory Remote Access Controls
description: Mandates that all remote access must occur exclusively through a VPN and that administrative access must be routed through a bastion host.

name: Administrative Session Security Requirements
description: Requires the implementation of multi-hop authentication and the logging and timing out of administrative sessions.

name: Unauthorized Access
description: The risk of unauthorized users gaining access to sensitive database tiers, production environments, or internal staff systems.

name: Network Subnetting
description: The use of separate subnets to isolate customer-facing systems from internal staff systems.

name: Virtual Private Network (VPN)
description: A secure tunnel used as the sole mechanism for remote access to the bank's internal network.

name: Bastion Host
description: A specialized server used as a secure gateway to provide administrative access to internal systems.

name: Multi-hop Authentication
description: A security mechanism requiring multiple stages of authentication to reach a target system.

name: Session Logging and Timeout
description: The recording of administrative session activity and the automatic termination of inactive sessions to prevent unauthorized use.

name: Endpoint Security Policy
description: A formal policy governing the security requirements for laptops, desktops, and mobile devices. It defines the standards for malware protection, device management, and data encryption to protect bank and customer data.

name: Mandatory EDR Deployment and Real-time Scanning
description: Requires the deployment of an Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tool with real-time scanning enabled to protect endpoints.
context: Endpoint detection and response (EDR) tool deployed

name: Daily Virus Definition Updates
description: Mandates that virus definitions for endpoint security tools must be updated on a daily basis.

name: Automatic Isolation of Suspicious Behavior
description: Requires that any behavior identified as suspicious by security tools must be isolated automatically.

name: Mandatory Mobile Device Management
description: Requires the use of Mobile Device Management (MDM) for all phones and tablets used within the bank's environment.

name: Universal Device Encryption
description: Mandates that encryption must be enforced on all devices, specifically those with access to customer data.
context: Mandatory for all devices with customer data access

name: Remote Wipe Capability for Lost Devices
description: Requires that all devices have the capability to be wiped remotely in the event they are lost.

name: OS Patching Timeframes
description: Defines the mandatory window for applying OS patches: within 30 days for standard patches and within 7 days for critical patches.
context: OS patches applied within 30 days (critical within 7)

name: Encryption Key Escrow
description: Requires that encryption keys for full-disk encryption be escrowed to ensure recovery is possible.

name: Malware Risk
description: The risk of malicious software infecting endpoints, addressed through EDR, real-time scanning, and daily updates.

name: Unauthorized Data Access
description: The risk of unauthorized parties accessing customer data via lost or stolen devices, mitigated by encryption and remote wipe capabilities.
context: Mandatory for all devices with customer data access

name: Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR)
description: A technical tool deployed to detect and respond to threats on laptops and desktops.
context: Endpoint detection and response (EDR) tool deployed

name: Mobile Device Management (MDM)
description: A management system used to enforce security policies on mobile phones and tablets.

name: Full-Disk Encryption
description: The use of BitLocker for Windows and FileVault for Mac to ensure data at rest is encrypted.

name: Application Security Policy
description: A formal policy governing the security requirements for application development, testing, and deployment within FirstUK Bank. It focuses on the Secure Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) to ensure code integrity and system resilience.

name: Mandatory Peer Code Review
description: Requires that all code undergo a peer review process prior to being deployed. This is a mandatory gate in the development lifecycle.

name: Security-Focused Code Review Standards
description: Mandates the use of a security-focused checklist during code reviews, specifically targeting authorization controls and the prevention of SQL injection and XSS.

name: Multi-Stage Testing Requirement
description: Obligates the performance of unit testing by developers, integration testing by QA, and load testing prior to any production release.

name: Security Testing Mandate
description: Requires the execution of security-specific testing, including penetration tests and vulnerability scans, as part of the SDLC.

name: Automated Deployment Requirement
description: Mandates the use of automated deployment processes and explicitly prohibits manual changes to the production environment.

name: Production Change Approval Requirement
description: Requires that all changes to the production environment be approved by the Change Advisory Board.
context: Change advisory board approval (changes to prod)

name: Deployment Rollback and Monitoring Obligation
description: Requires that a documented rollback plan be in place and that production monitoring be enabled for all deployments.

name: SQL Injection
description: A specific technical vulnerability where malicious SQL statements are inserted into entry fields for execution, which the policy seeks to prevent via code review.

name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
description: A security vulnerability involving the injection of malicious scripts into trusted websites, addressed through mandatory code review checks.

name: Penetration Testing
description: An operational security safeguard used to identify vulnerabilities by simulating attacks against the application.

name: Vulnerability Scanning
description: An automated tool used to detect known security weaknesses within the application environment.

name: Change Advisory Board Approval
description: A governance gate requiring formal approval before any changes are promoted to the production environment.
context: Change advisory board approval (changes to prod)

name: Production Monitoring
description: The implementation of monitoring tools to ensure the stability and security of the application after deployment.

name: Developers
description: Staff responsible for the creation of code and the execution of unit testing.

name: Quality Assurance (QA)
description: Staff collective responsible for performing integration testing on the application.

name: Change Advisory Board
description: A governing body with the authority to approve or reject changes to the production environment.
context: Change advisory board approval (changes to prod)

name: API Security Policy
description: A formal set of security standards governing the implementation and design of APIs at FirstUK Bank, focusing on gateway controls and secure design principles.

name: Kong API Gateway
description: The primary technical gateway used to enforce authentication, rate limiting, and request validation for API traffic.

name: Mandatory API Authentication
description: Requirement that API access must be secured using a combination of API keys and JSON Web Tokens (JWT).

name: API Rate Limiting Requirement
description: Requirement to implement rate limiting on the API Gateway to prevent system abuse.

name: API Request Validation
description: Requirement to validate incoming requests at the gateway level to prevent injection attacks.

name: API Monitoring and Alerting
description: Requirement to maintain monitoring and alerting capabilities for API Gateway activity.

name: API Input Sanitization
description: Design requirement to sanitize all inputs to ensure secure API processing.

name: API Output Encoding
description: Design requirement to encode outputs to prevent Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities.

name: Role-Based API Authorization
description: Requirement to implement authorization checks based on user or system roles.

name: API Call Audit Logging
description: Requirement to maintain audit logs of all API calls for security and compliance tracking.

name: API Abuse
description: The risk of API resources being overwhelmed or misused, mitigated by rate limiting.

name: Injection Attack
description: The risk of malicious code being injected into API requests, mitigated by request validation.

name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
description: The risk of malicious scripts being executed in a user's browser via API outputs, mitigated by output encoding.

name: Audit Logging
description: The operational mechanism of recording API calls to provide a traceable history of system access.

name: Vulnerability Management Policy
description: A formal policy governing the identification and management of security vulnerabilities across production systems, deployments, and third-party libraries.

name: Weekly Production System Vulnerability Scanning
description: A mandatory requirement stating that vulnerability scans must be performed on production systems on a weekly basis.

name: Pre-deployment Vulnerability Scanning
description: A mandatory requirement that vulnerability scanning must be conducted for every release prior to deployment.

name: Continuous Third-party Library Scanning
description: A mandatory requirement for the continuous scanning of third-party libraries to identify vulnerabilities.

name: Nessus Network Vulnerability Scanner
description: The specific technical tool used for performing network-level vulnerability scanning.

name: Burp Suite Web Application Scanner
description: The specific technical tool used for scanning web applications for vulnerabilities.

name: Trivy Container Image Scanner
description: The specific technical tool used for scanning container images for security vulnerabilities.

name: Dependency Checker
description: Technical tools, such as npm audit, used to check software dependencies for known vulnerabilities.

name: Information Security Vulnerability
description: The risk of security weaknesses in production systems, web applications, container images, or third-party libraries being exploited.

name: Patch Management Policy
description: A formal policy governing the identification, testing, and deployment of software patches based on criticality timelines to ensure system security.

name: Critical Patch Deployment Timeline
description: Mandatory requirement to deploy patches identified as 'Critical' within a maximum timeframe of 7 days.

name: High Patch Deployment Timeline
description: Mandatory requirement to deploy patches identified as 'High' within a maximum timeframe of 30 days.

name: Medium Patch Deployment Timeline
description: Mandatory requirement to deploy patches identified as 'Medium' within a maximum timeframe of 60 days.

name: Low Patch Deployment Timeline
description: Mandatory requirement to deploy patches identified as 'Low' within a maximum timeframe of 90 days.

name: Patch Deployment Process Sequence
description: A mandatory five-step operational sequence for patch management: vulnerability identification, vendor release, non-production testing, production deployment, and final verification.

name: Vulnerability Risk
description: The risk associated with unpatched software vulnerabilities that could be exploited, categorized by criticality levels (Critical, High, Medium, Low).

name: Non-Production Testing
description: An operational safeguard requiring patches to be tested in a non-production environment prior to deployment in the production environment.

name: Post-Deployment Verification and Monitoring
description: A monitoring mechanism to verify the successful application of a patch and monitor system stability following production deployment.

name: Third-Party Risk Policy
description: A policy governing the management of risks associated with third-party vendors, specifically focusing on security assessments and ongoing monitoring requirements.

name: Mandatory Pre-Assessment Security Questionnaire
description: Requirement that a security questionnaire must be completed as part of the pre-assessment process for third-party vendors.

name: SOC 2 Type II Audit Review
description: Requirement to review a vendor's SOC 2 Type II audit report during the pre-assessment phase, where such a report is available.
context: SOC 2 Type II audit reviewed (if available)

name: Penetration Test Result Review
description: Requirement to review penetration test results during the pre-assessment phase, if applicable to the vendor.

name: Vendor Reference Checks
description: Requirement to conduct reference checks with other customers of the third-party vendor during pre-assessment.

name: Annual Vendor Re-assessment
description: Mandate for the bank to perform a security re-assessment of third-party vendors on an annual basis.

name: Vendor Incident Notification Timeframe
description: Obligation for vendors to notify FirstUK Bank of security incidents within a 24-hour Service Level Agreement (SLA) window.

name: Right to Audit Third-Party Vendors
description: Provision granting FirstUK Bank the explicit right to conduct audits of its third-party vendors.
context: Audit rights (FirstUK Bank can audit vendor)

name: Security Service Level Agreement Requirement
description: Requirement for a formal Service Level Agreement (SLA) specifically covering security standards for third-party vendors.

name: Third-Party Risk
description: Risks arising from the use of external vendors, specifically regarding their security posture and ability to protect bank data.

name: Vendor Security Questionnaire
description: An operational tool used to collect security data from vendors during the pre-assessment phase.

name: SOC 2 Type II Audit Review
description: The process of reviewing external audit reports to verify a vendor's internal controls.
context: SOC 2 Type II audit reviewed (if available)

name: Penetration Testing Review
description: The review of technical security testing results to identify vulnerabilities in a vendor's environment.

name: Third-Party Vendor
description: External entities providing services to FirstUK Bank, subject to security assessments, audit rights, and incident notification SLAs.

name: FirstUK Bank
description: The governing institution responsible for conducting vendor assessments and exercising audit rights.

name: Third-Party Access Policy
description: A policy governing the access granted to contractors and vendors to bank systems, ensuring access is limited, monitored, and secured.

name: Principle of Least Privilege for Third Parties
description: Mandates that contractor and vendor access must be restricted only to the specific systems required for their role.

name: Time-Bound Access and Auto-Revocation
description: Requires that third-party access be granted for a limited duration and automatically revoked upon expiry.

name: Mandatory Activity Logging for Third Parties
description: Obligates the bank to monitor and log all actions performed by contractors and vendors within the systems.

name: Multi-Factor Authentication Requirement
description: Mandates the use of Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for all third-party access to systems.

name: Third-Party Legal and Security Agreement Obligation
